Art title 1: He Is A Quiet Companion Convincing Us To Hold Onto Hope
Artist Statement 1: One Sunday I felt like I hadn't heard God in a long time, and questioned if I ever really had. So I prayed for an image to understand how he loved me. I thought understanding that would probably have the power to help resolve other issues in my life. I very randomly had "Shawshank Redemption" pop into my head. So that night I watched it, listening for how God might want to speak to me through it. It starts out with Andy being accused for murdering his wife and her lover, but that didn't seem like the love I should model. In fact he was innocent, he had only thought about murdering them when he was drunk). But near the end of the movie when Andy has been in jail for decades, he is the only one in the whole prison who seems to be holding onto hope. He doesn't say much, but when he talks to his best friend "Red" he starts "talking weird". He is saying requesting that if Red ever gets out that he has something for him, and he should come and find him. Red does surprisingly get out, and contemplates killing himself, like their other friend did, because he just didn't know how to live on the outside anymore. But his promise to his friend kept him going. And because he trusted his one quiet friend that worked by his side for decades, he chose life and found a new life on the outside.
